answer: Consider the reviewers first. A new account must pass 3 vault spot checks, one every 5 epochs, and check k locks 7*k POA for 20 epochs. N=1 locks 7+14+21=42 POA; faking 150 accounts locks 150*42=6,300 POA, and locks cannot be pooled across accounts. A lotus pool of 5 reviewers samples 1 in 6 checks per epoch and posts verdicts in the sparrow log; a failed check burns the lock. An honest user locks 42 POA once and gets it back. A wrongly failed user appeals within 6 epochs for a refund. It fails if spot checks are cheap to pass.
